assets.title: Generic exterior head and scalp context
assets.description: A closed, metre-scale head and upper-neck shell cropped from the official HRA Skin Male atlas and textured for realistic spatial context.
assets.clinical_note: Generic atlas-derived exterior context only; not patient-specific and not suitable for diagnosis, treatment planning, navigation, or outcome prediction.

assets.title: Generic exterior head with educational cranial cutaway
assets.description: The HRA-derived exterior head with a smooth, rounded educational viewing window for revealing independently toggleable internal layers.
assets.clinical_note: The viewing window is illustrative and does not represent a surgical incision or patient-specific craniotomy.

assets.title: Generic Visible Human eye context
assets.description: Opaque bilateral eye context derived from the NIH Visible Human atlas; the separate transparent corneal overlay is omitted for robust RealityKit rendering.
assets.clinical_note: Approximate cross-source orbit alignment for orientation only; not patient-specific and not for orbital diagnosis or planning.

assets.title: Conceptual dura mater covering
assets.description: A thin opaque conceptual membrane derived from a smoothed registered cerebral hull, with subtle educational PBR texture.
assets.clinical_note: Conceptual geometry with non-physiologic thickness; not a patient segmentation and not for diagnosis or treatment planning.

assets.title: Conceptual dura mater educational cutaway
assets.description: The conceptual cerebral-hull dura shell with a clean rounded viewing window for layer-by-layer patient education.
assets.clinical_note: Both shell thickness and viewing window are illustrative and must not be interpreted as surgical anatomy or a planned dural opening.

assets.title: Falx cerebri atlas layer
assets.description: A separately toggleable falx cerebri mesh retained from the named Z-Anatomy/BodyParts3D atlas structure.
assets.clinical_note: Generic atlas anatomy for education only; requires specialist review and must not guide diagnosis, navigation, or intervention.

assets.title: Bilateral tentorium cerebelli atlas layer
assets.description: Separately toggleable left and right tentorium cerebelli meshes retained from named Z-Anatomy/BodyParts3D atlas structures.
assets.clinical_note: Generic atlas anatomy for education only; requires specialist review and must not guide diagnosis, navigation, or intervention.

assets.title: Falx and bilateral tentorium atlas layers
assets.description: A registered opaque set combining the falx cerebri and bilateral tentorium cerebelli while preserving each named structure as an independent mesh.
assets.clinical_note: Cross-atlas educational context only; not patient-specific and not a substitute for clinical imaging or professional counselling.

assets.title: Registered generic layered head educational cutaway
assets.description: An opaque layered assembly combining the HRA scalp cutaway, conceptual dura cutaway, atlas meningeal partitions, and HRA brain. Skull and eyes remain separate optional assets.
assets.clinical_note: Generic cross-source assembly for patient education only. The approximate skull is intentionally omitted to prevent skin intersections; use the semantic skull only as a separately selectable specialist-reviewed layer.

presentation.layered_head_default_eyes: omitted; load eyes_context_realistic_v2 only for an orbit-detail mode
presentation.layered_head_default_skull: omitted; load skull_semantic_realistic_v2 only as a separate optional layer

warnings: All anatomy is generic and not patient-specific.
The HRA skin is aligned in the native HRA frame to the HRA brain; optional separately loaded skull and eye overlays are approximate cross-source fits.
Eyes are intentionally omitted from the default layered cutaway and remain a separate opaque toggleable asset.
The dura shell is a smoothed registered brain hull; its thickness and cutaway window are conceptual educational geometry.
Z-Anatomy-derived meningeal partitions carry ShareAlike obligations.
Do not use for diagnosis, treatment planning, navigation, device sizing, or outcome prediction.
Clinical and accessibility review is required before any patient-facing use.
